task.name: Avery Lane
task.subject: Prospective PhD supervision enquiry — socially engaged art & community wellbeing
task.body:
Dear Avery Lane,

I am Student 001, an MA Illustration graduate from the University for the Creative Arts. I am exploring practice-led doctoral opportunities for 2027 at RMIT University.

My proposed research connects illustration with socially engaged art & community wellbeing. I would value the chance to discuss whether this direction could fit your supervision and the university's research environment.

I have attached my CV and portfolio, together with a research proposal. Would you be available for a brief conversation about research fit and the next application steps?

Kind regards,
Student 001

My proposed research connects illustration with public art, visual narrative & memory. I would value the chance to discuss whether this direction could fit your supervision and the university's research environment.

I have attached my CV and portfolio, together with a research proposal and a writing sample. Would you be available for a brief conversation about research fit and the next application steps?

Kind regards,
